name: BZH natural (scene-specific): footage neutral & realistic, green only in design
notes: Presenter takes mix daylight + warm practical light (wall R/B 1.22): remove ~2/3 of the warm cast (R x0.955, B x1.055), keep skin warm; gentle S-curve with highlight roll-off; subtle vignette. Renders: no hue change at all, only contrast/roll-off/sharpness so they sit with the presenter. Green lives in typography, graphics, backgrounds and transitions only.
